deterministic_order: X0..1 outer, Y0..3 next, D lexicographic {0,1}^6 inner; Z=0
deterministic_types: case=[X,Y,D0,...,D5], public/error/delta vectors and cleanup are exact integers; public_equal,clear_ok,legal_equivalent are strict booleans.
stochastic_order: Lexicographic eight rounding-UP bits [six old,prep,inverse]; fixed X1,Y1,Z0,D allzero
stochastic_types: coins/outputs/errors/cleanup are exact integers except clear_ok strict bool. Each bit0=floor,1=ceil at its half-integer ADD, including negative uncompute.
moment_types: Covariances are reduced rational [numerator,positive denominator] integer pairs:6x6 old/shared,6vector shared-cleanup, scalar cleanup variance. Histogram [[signed residual,count]] sorted by residual. coin_cases integer256.
scope: Whole-updated-sum rounding; public outputs and moments measured before potentially illegal CLEAR. Primary literal integer interpreter; independent oracle parity/probability formulas plus separate Fraction distance/parity interpreter. No primary code/data exchange before both first seals.
